program.major: Mechanical Engineering (Renewable Energy and Environmental Flows)

notes: Full mechanical engineering core PLUS four of the five technical electives chosen from the renewable-energy list, including both asterisked (*) core courses (MAE 119 and MAE 122). Verified against live catalog; SIO 143 and SIO 174 added to the Environmental Chemistry group (omitted in harvest).

buckets.label: Lower-division physics & chemistry
buckets.note: CHEM 6AH may be taken in place of CHEM 6A.

buckets.label: Upper-division engineering core
buckets.note: Requires MAE 160 OR MAE 131B (one of the two), plus all other listed courses.

buckets.label: Specialization core (required, asterisked)
buckets.note: Both asterisked core courses required as part of the four specialization TEs.

buckets.label: Specialization technical electives (Renewable Energy and Environmental Flows)
buckets.note: Two additional courses (beyond MAE 119 and MAE 122) chosen from the Environmental Flows, Energy, or Environmental Chemistry groups to total four specialization TEs. SIO 141 is cross-listed as CHEM 174. Most CENG and CHEM courses are also accepted with petition.

buckets.label: Free technical elective
buckets.note: Fifth TE; any departmentally approved upper-division/graduate technical elective.

buckets.label: Humanities & social sciences (GE/HSS)
buckets.note: Engineering-major HSS/GE bucket (24 units). UCSD engineering majors satisfy this through their college's general-education program, which differs by the six undergraduate colleges (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, Seventh). No fixed course list at the major level; covered by the college GE section of the audit.

buckets.label: Minimum total units for degree
buckets.note: Standard UCSD BS minimum of 180 total quarter units for the degree. No course list; a total-unit-count requirement.
